props.name: reveal
props.description: `hover`: with a mouse, the actions stay hidden until the row is hovered, holds focus, is `active` or has a menu open, and then take the place of the rest of `InboxItemTrailing` (the timestamp, the marks, the attention dot), which steps aside. A touch screen has no hover, so there they stay hidden at rest too: put the same actions in the row's press-and-hold menu (and its swipe), as mail apps do.
